name: Galleon Hunter Rory

intro.text: I'm after the Tobermory galleon. Armada ship, 1588, holds a fortune in gold. I have a metal detector, a boat and a dream. The dream is doing most of the work.

win: I'll find it yet. I always find something. Last week it was a Tesco bag.
after: The legend says she was blown up by an accident, a Spanish ship called the San Juan de Sicilia. Four hundred years of looking has found a lot of mud and a handful of cannon.
